tcgmini.homepage.description: Shown when browsing the TCGmini homepage.

tcgmini.simulator.description: Subtitle shown together with playingMatch, naming the app.

tcgmini.inMatch.description: Tooltip for the small 'playing' icon while on the board.

tcgmini.searchingCards.description: Shown when browsing/searching the card database.

tcgmini.checkingMeta.description: Shown when checking the best/meta decks.

tcgmini.draftingDeck.description: Shown when drafting a deck in Draft mode.

tcgmini.makingTierlist.description: Shown when creating a tier list.

tcgmini.browsingSite.description: Fallback shown for any other page on the site.

tcgmini.formatStandard.description: Shown as the match subtitle when playing in Standard format.

tcgmini.formatAdvanced.description: Shown as the match subtitle when playing in Advanced format.

tcgmini.formatSandbox.description: Shown as the match subtitle when playing in Sandbox mode.

tcgmini.winning.description: Shown in the match state when the local player has more points than their opponent.

tcgmini.losing.description: Shown in the match state when the local player has fewer points than their opponent.

tcgmini.tied.description: Shown in the match state when both players have the same number of points, and reused as the result headline for a drawn match.

tcgmini.victory.description: Result headline shown on the post-match screen when the local player won.

tcgmini.defeat.description: Result headline shown on the post-match screen when the local player lost.

tcgmini.matchEnded.description: Tooltip for the small icon while the post-match result screen is showing.
